subject: Clearwell: workspace & API key kickstart — access plan and invites
messages:
From: Sara Kim <sara.kim@clearwellhealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dan Ortega <dan.ortega@clearwellhealth.com>, Clearwell IT <itops@clearwellhealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Kickoff — Clearwell workspace + API key access

Hi Vivek / Monica,

Thanks for the chat yesterday. We're ready to get the Clearwell pilot workspace set up so our devs can start smoke-testing the integration. Primary asks up front:

- A single organization (workspace) for Clearwell with one admin seat and two developer seats.
- API key for service integration plus a short-lived invite flow for devs.
- Simple role matrix: Admin, Developer, Read-only Auditor.
- Baseline quotas so we don't hit throttles during initial testing.

I've attached a short requirements doc and a draft MAP (mutual action plan) to this email. Can you confirm the provisioning steps and an ETA for invites + key? We prefer keys seeded into our CI (we'll provide the repo name privately). Also flag any compliance notes for audit logs / retention.

Proposed kickoff window: this week (10/5–10/9) — we can do a 30-min handoff call any morning PT.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Kim
Director, Platform Integrations
Clearwell Health

Attachments: Clearwell_Org_Requirements.docx, Clearwell_Onboarding_MAP_v1.xlsx

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Kim <sara.kim@clearwellhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-03T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff — Clearwell workspace + API key access

Hi Sara — thanks for the clear list. Below is the plan I propose; we'll follow up with an invite + MAP update.

1) Provisioning (same day):
   - Create organization: "clearwell-health" workspace in our console.
   - Seed one admin API key (label: clearwell-admin-20261003) and two developer API keys for initial dev seats. Admin key is long-lived; developer keys can be rotated.

2) Roles & projects (day 1):
   - Roles: Admin, Developer, Auditor (pre-baked roles in console).
   - Create project "clearwell-pilot" and assign the two dev API keys to that project.

3) Quotas & limits (day 1):
   - Baseline quota: 50k tokens/day for pilot workspace; burst policy to 150k/day for the first 72 hours. We'll monitor and scale if needed.

4) Security & logging (day 1–2):
   - Enable org-level audit logs (7-day retention by default; we can extend).
   - We will provide a syslog endpoint / S3 bucket option for push-based audit export.

5) Handoff call / invites (schedule):
   - I'll send calendar invites for a 30-min handoff on Tuesday 10/6 at 09:00 PT (tentative).

6) Deliverables:
   - Seed keys (names and partial fingerprints in the MAP), invitation links, checklist CSV, and a small runbook with rotation guidance.

If that looks good I'll provision the org this afternoon and post the invite links in the MAP.

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Solutions Lead, Customer Onboarding
Redwood Inference

--- Original attachments referenced: Clearwell_Onboarding_MAP_v1.xlsx, Clearwell_Org_Requirements.docx

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Sara Kim <sara.kim@clearwellhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-03T13:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff — Clearwell workspace + API key access

Adding a couple of implementation notes:

- If Clearwell expects sustained throughput beyond the pilot bursts, recommend discussing Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity) ahead of ramp — we should capture that as an optional line item in the MAP.
- For CI seeding we can provide instructions to use long-lived "service" keys stored in your KMS; we recommend a rotation cadence of 90 days.
- I'll create a small quota alert (Slack + email) once provisioning is done so your engineers don't hit limits unexpectedly.

I'll be on the handoff call to walk through project assignment and quota tuning.

Thanks,
Rishi
Director, Performance & Scale
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Kim <sara.kim@clearwellhealth.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-04T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff — Clearwell workspace + API key access

Sara — attached is an updated MAP with the provisioning checklist filled in and expected owner for each step. Quick highlights:

- Provisioning ETA: 10/3 (today) — org created, keys seeded, invites queued.
- Handoff call: 10/06T16:00Z (09:00 PT) — calendar invite sent.
- Deliverables to expect in the drive folder: seeded-keys.csv (fingerprints only), onboarding-checklist.csv, and a short runbook (onboarding-runbook.md).

Next steps for your team before the call:
- Confirm the two dev emails for invites (we'll use the exact addresses for SSO mapping).
- Confirm whether audit logs need 30/90 day retention.

Links I've added into the MAP: HubSpot deal, Drive folder, and the pre-filled DocuSign pack for the SOW signature (if you want the SOW completed before the pilot).

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-kickstart-checklist.csv, Clearwell_Onboarding_MAP_v1.xlsx

From: Sara Kim <sara.kim@clearwellhealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dan Ortega <dan.ortega@clearwellhealth.com>, Clearwell IT <itops@clearwellhealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T15:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff — Clearwell workspace + API key access

Thanks everyone — this looks great. A couple quick confirmations: 

- Developer invites: please send to devs@clearwellhealth.com and eng-lead@clearwellhealth.com.
- Audit retention: start with 30 days; we may extend once we validate log volume.
- DocuSign: we'll sign the pilot SOW today, but we'd like keys and invites live before the EOD so our devs can run a sanity test tomorrow morning.

I'll look for the seeded-keys.csv in the shared folder and confirm once our CI picks them up. See you on Tuesday 10/6 at 09:00 PT.
